svg.font-family: 'Roboto Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace
svg.title: The model's matmuls, tuned in a chain
svg.desc: Achieved TFLOPS against rows, 8 to 8,192, for each of the four matmuls of a layer, timed as the model runs them, each matmul waiting on the one before: MLX's matmul, and the tile bench/tune_gemm.py picked (MLX's matmul where nothing beat it by 3%). The dotted line is the 33 TFLOPS peak.
svg.text: The model's matmuls, tuned as the model runs them
TFLOPS by rows (tokens), log scale, 8 dependent matmuls; dotted: the 33 TFLOPS peak
the tile the tuner picked (or MLX's, where it was faster)
